 Order

The present appeal preferred by the claimants under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988,
seeks enhancement of compensation awarded by the learned Motor Accident Claim Tribunal, vide its award dated 09.04.2019.
The petition is accompanied by an application seeking condonation of delay.
2. Upon the appellant taking steps, issue notice to the respondents through all permissible modes.
Reply to the application be filed within six weeks.

Rejoinder thereto, if any, be filed within four weeks thereafter.
3.
